In this case, we have to use the identity  $1+{cot}^{2}⁡x={csc}^{2}⁡x.$ Substituting this into our integral gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\pi /4}^{\pi /3}\frac{3({cot}^{2}⁡x+1)}{\operatorname{tan}⁡x\operatorname{csc}⁡x}\,\text{d}x & =3{\int }_{\pi /4}^{\pi /3}\frac{{cot}^{2}⁡x+1}{\operatorname{tan}⁡x\operatorname{csc}⁡x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =3{\int }_{\pi /4}^{\pi /3}\frac{{csc}^{2}⁡x}{\operatorname{tan}⁡x\operatorname{csc}⁡x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =3{\int }_{\pi /4}^{\pi /3}\frac{\operatorname{csc}⁡x}{\operatorname{tan}⁡x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =3{\int }_{\pi /4}^{\pi /3}\operatorname{csc}⁡x\operatorname{cot}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =-3\operatorname{csc}⁡x\,{|}_{\pi /4}^{\pi /3} \\  & =-3\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3})+3\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4}) \\  & =-3\cdot \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}+3\cdot \sqrt{2} \\  & =3\sqrt{2}-2\sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
